data.narrative:
PLD Space is a Series G space and aerospace company that has raised €120M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 6 public Space & Aerospace companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE.

Only one valuation method is reliably applicable given data constraints. Stage-Progression anchors to the company's €120M total raised as a proxy for enterprise value, applying a 1.25x step-up multiplier typical of Series G advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $261M. A sensitivity band of ±15% produces a low bound of $222M and high bound of $300M, reflecting execution and market timing risk inherent at this stage.

The Peer-Median approach cannot be applied due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables in Space & Aerospace (only 1 adjacent-stage peer identified, below the minimum threshold of 3). Public-Comp Anchoring is inapplicable because PLD Space's revenue is not disclosed. The 6-ticker public median P/S multiple of 24.4x cannot be leveraged without revenue data. The valuation range of $222M–$300M (median $261M) is therefore supported by stage-progression mechanics alone. Key uncertainties include revenue visibility, capital efficiency relative to peers, and near-term funding environment for growth-stage aerospace ventures.
